name: TBX Term Import
changes: The TBX Term Import notice for a Pro feature now has a Sponsor on GitHub button.
tip: Language labels are compared as written, so en, en-US and en-GB are separate choices. Pick the exact two labels for your columns.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. TBX Term Import is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to bring your term bases into Obsidian.
